<div style="margin:0 5px">Lootfrogs are unlocked by buying the [[Stargazing#FroggerUpgrade|Frogger Drone Enhancement]] after unlocking the [[Stargazing#Black Hole|Black hole]], making them late game content. The frogger drone suit has to be equipped and fueled in order for lootfrogs to spawn. The chance for a lootfrog to spawn is processed alongside frogger drone's bomb firing, meaning with a frogger suit level of 15, frogs have a chance to spawn every 7.5 seconds of true time. 
</div></div>

==Lootfrog upgrades==
{{See also|Stats#Lootfrogs}}
You can improve Lootfrogs by increasing their stats
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_Capacity|Lootfrog Capacity]] - Increases the maximum amount of lootfrogs that can be on screen at the same time
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_Loot_Multiplier|Lootfrog Loot Multiplier]] - Increases the lootfrog loot multiplier
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Lootfrog_Chance|Golden Lootfrog Chance]] - Increases the chance for lootfrog to appear as golden
* [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Lootfrog_Multiplier|Golden Lootfrog Multiplier]] - Increases the golden lootfrog loot multiplier (base x2)
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_Triple_Spawn_Chance|Lootfrog Triple Spawn Chance]] - Increases the chance for spawning 3 lootfrogs at once instead of 1
* [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_10x_Spawn_Chance|Lootfrog 10x Spawn Chance]] - Increases the chance for spawning 10 lootfrogs at once instead of 1
* [[Stats#tabber-Big_Lootfrog_Chance|Big Lootfrog Chance]] - Increases the chance for a lootfrog to spawn as Big variant
* [[Stats#tabber-Big_Lootfrog_Multi|Big Lootfrog Multiplier]] - Increases the big lootfrog loot multiplier (base x5)
* [[Stats#tabber-Massive_Lootfrog_Chance|Massive Lootfrog Chance]] - Increases the chance for a big lootfrog to spawn as massive variant
* [[Stats#tabber-Massive_Lootfrog_Multi|Massive Lootfrog Multiplier]] - Increases the massive lootfrog loot multiplier (base x3)

==Loot==
All Lootfrog rewards are affected by the [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_Loot_Multiplier|Lootfrog Loot Multiplier]], while a Big Lootfrog and a Massive Lootfrog rewards are also multiplied by the [[Stats#tabber-Big_Lootfrog_Multi|Big Lootfrog Multiplier]] and [[Stats#tabber-Massive_Lootfrog_Multi|Massive Lootfrog Multiplier]] respectively. Additionally the Golden Lootfrog rewards are further multiplied by the [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Lootfrog_Multiplier|Golden Lootfrog Multiplier]].

When looting for the [[Items#Frogspawn|Frogspawn]] or the [[Items#LootbugLantern|Lootbug Lantern]] the quantity obtained is limited to a certain amount depending on the Frog type looted even if the current multipliers would grant a greater amount. For example, if both [[Stats#tabber-Lootfrog_Loot_Multiplier|Lootfrog Loot Multiplier]] and [[Stats#tabber-Golden_Lootfrog_Multiplier|Golden Lootfrog Multiplier]] are at 2x, a Golden Lootfrog that rolls to grant [[Items#Tier_3_items|Frogspawn]], it will still only give 3 [[Items#Tier_3_items|Frogspawn]] despite the multipliers combining to 4x.

Frogspawn is limited to a maximum of x3 for basic Lootfrog and Big Lootfrog and x6 for Massive Lootfrog, while Lootbug Lantern is limited to a maximum of x3 for basic Lootfrog, x6 for Big Lootfrog and x9 for Massive Lootfrog.

==Lootfrog Hats==
The hats worn by Lootfrogs are entirely cosmetic, with two exceptions being the Card Hat frog [[File:Lootfrog_35.png|20x20px]] and the Flaming Hat frog [[File:Lootfrog_40.png|20x20px]]<ref name="flaming">Chance is 1/100 to be on fire</ref>, which are guaranteed to give polychrome and infernal shards for the [[Cards#LootfrogMiscCard|Lootfrog]] or [[Cards#GoldenLootfrogMiscCard|Golden Lootfrog]] misc cards. Other frogs provide the normal 1/200 chance.

Certain themed hats are only displayed during specific months (for example: specific Christmas hats are only shown in December).
